    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp to throw runtime errors on I/O failure and corruption instead of returning empty results.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "TxIndex previously returned false on disk read errors or corruption, silently reporting existing transactions as missing. Commit fa5c96a112 notes that 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception,' protecting callers from treating index failures as non-existent data."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to surface internal I/O errors and check block availability.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "RPC and REST endpoints previously misreported confirmed transactions as missing when underlying reads failed due to disk errors or block pruning. As noted in doc/release-notes-35728.md, endpoints like getrawtransaction and /rest/tx now distinguish un-downloaded or pruned blocks from missing transactions and surface internal errors rather than returning empty results."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test/functional/test_runner.py and functional tests merely cover the RPC and index changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional tests test the specific index and RPC behavior changes and adding feature_io_errors.py to test_runner.py is routine test registration rather than test framework infrastructure work."

categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp to throw runtime errors on I/O failure and corruption instead of returning empty results.
categories.rationale: TxIndex previously returned false on disk read errors or corruption, silently reporting existing transactions as missing. Commit fa5c96a112 notes that 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception,' protecting callers from treating index failures as non-existent data.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to surface internal I/O errors and check block availability.
categories.rationale: RPC and REST endpoints previously misreported confirmed transactions as missing when underlying reads failed due to disk errors or block pruning. As noted in doc/release-notes-35728.md, endpoints like getrawtransaction and /rest/tx now distinguish un-downloaded or pruned blocks from missing transactions and surface internal errors rather than returning empty results.
